source: West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources, Health Statistics Center, West Virginia Vital Statistics annual reports 2016-2020, 'Selected Causes of Resident Deaths: Number and Rate by County'
note: Resident deaths (place of residence) by county as printed in the West Virginia Vital Statistics annual reports, Table 'Selected Causes of Resident Deaths: Number and Rate by County' (14 pages of four counties and a state column per year; report editions 2016-2020, PDF files downloaded 2026-10-10 with the owner's yes: 2016 4,823,259 bytes SHA-256 25f0b7e88e962d36; 2017 4,874,445 bytes SHA-256 fc4a79b54404578d; 2018 5,139,268 bytes SHA-256 299333a57ac39e7a; 2019 5,065,863 bytes SHA-256 36938c02b14929b2; 2020 5,304,180 bytes SHA-256 6ff0b7ec4c258b37). Every cell is an exact count, zeros print as 0, and the reports state no small-number suppression. For every printed row the 55 county counts add to the state column, except falls 2017: county sum 353 vs printed state total 354 and one HIV row in 2020 (8 vs 10; not a map measure). Causes kept: all deaths, malignant neoplasms, diabetes mellitus, Alzheimer's disease, diseases of the heart, cerebrovascular diseases, influenza and pneumonia, chronic lower respiratory diseases, chronic liver disease and cirrhosis, nephritis/nephrotic syndrome/nephrosis, falls, intentional self-harm, assault (homicide), COVID-19 (2020 only) and all accidents (raw key, not a map measure). Poisonings are not drug overdoses and are not kept. Each report states on its front matter: 'All material appearing in this report is in the public domain and may be reproduced or copied without permission; citation as to source, however, is appreciated.' and recommends the citation 'West Virginia Vital Statistics, <year>, West Virginia Department of Health and Human Resources, Bureau for Public Health, Health Statistics Center'. Stated and non-barring: terms status stated_review (cite the Health Statistics Center). Counts only. These years are the same publisher and tables as the 1999-2006 bundle wv_hsc_vital; they are a separate bundle so they can be approved on their own.
